title: Reddit audit of TRIBE v2 finds motion selectivity but no retinotopy/tonotopy
summary: A researcher on Reddit reports running classic retinotopy, tonotopy, and motion-localizer stimuli through Meta&\#x27;s TRIBE v2 fMRI prediction model and fitting standard topographic models. They report no significant retinotopic map \(d=0.05\) or tonotopic map \(ρ=-0.07, even with loudness controlled\), but strong motion selectivity in MT+ \(d=4.31, 52× enrichment over chance\). An eccentricity effect became significant and "correct" only under three stimulus-geometry controls, which the author interprets as an image-statistics confound rather than a positional code. The work is a self-funded solo project posted with code and a paper link, not peer-reviewed; according to the post, TRIBE v2&\#x27;s own paper did not test these topographic maps.
